Terrible experience. The communication was awful, a clear case of deception. We were interested in the 999 baht weight loss injection package. We discussed and paid a 500 baht deposit via chat. They asked for our height and weight to calculate our BMI. They said our BMI was too high and recommended hormone injections. We agreed, and double-checked, "Is the 999 baht price for each injection, with no extra charges?" They replied, "Yes, no extra charges." Happy to get a good price, we agreed. On the day of our appointment, they rushed us to pay the remaining 499 baht. After payment, they asked for our height and weight again, calculated the price, and recommended 2.5 mg injections at 3000 baht per week after the discount. We were confused because the price we discussed in the chat wasn't this amount. We even double-checked if it was definitely 999. Why did it turn out like that when we got there? They replied that 999 was the price for 0.5 mg, but they recommended 2.5 mg for better results than 0.5 mg. We asked what that chat conversation was all about. Why did they use our weight and height to calculate our BMI? Why didn't they tell us how many mg 999 covered based on our weight and height, and how much we needed? Why didn't they just say the approximate price was? We double-checked the price, and they confirmed it was. They replied, "We're sorry, the person who answered the chat is from a different branch; they're from the Bangkok branch." When we wanted a refund, they said we had to wait several days for the paperwork to be completed. In the end, we had to pay an extra 2001 baht, bringing the total to 3000 baht.
*** I'm so upset and disappointed. This was my first procedure, and I went there with so much hope. I came out feeling extremely disappointed. That's it, I'm done with them. Anyone who thinks this is a bad experience should be aware. It was terrible. Yes, they didn't lie, they just didn't tell the customer everything. The price shown in the advertisement was completely different from the actual price on-site. ******* If there were a zero-star rating system, I'd give it zero stars, although one star might be too much. Good luck with your business.
